analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 49.1 remains in neutral territory, MACD histogram shows improvement but lacks conviction for trend reversal. Closed down 3.40% over the last 5 days, maintaining the 5-day low vs 20-day low pattern, but failed to break resistance at $300.20 from a 56.7% position relative to 52-week high. ADX at 10.8 indicates a non-trending phase. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

Today, RSI at 49.1 and improving MACD histogram supported a bullish bias, but a 5-day losing streak and failure to break resistance lack conviction for a trend reversal. Buy score adjusted down from 7 to 5, shifting to a wait-and-see stance.
